question: C Site Haven, spike planted, 3v2 your favor, 31s. You're Omen at C Link with 2 smokes and Paranoia. How do you run the retake?

options.label: Smoke both defuse angles (C Long and default plant), then push onto the spike grouped from Garage and Link
options.explication_courte: The smokes cut the post-plant crossfire from the remaining 2 defenders, letting all 3 enter the spike at once. In a 3v2, coordinated util + numbers forces the ATK to give up an angle.

options.label: Use Paranoia along the main axis, then rush in before throwing any smokes
options.explication_courte: The flash blinds post-plant defenders for a window, but entering without smokes leaves crossfires open if Paranoia misses an angle. Playable with perfect timing — riskier than the smoke+entry combo.

sources_option.citation: The retake is not won when you get onto site, but when you make the attackers unable to stop the defuse; flashes help but layering utility beats a single flash entry.

options.label: Dump all 2 smokes and Paranoia at once pre-entry, then wait 8s before pushing
options.explication_courte: Throwing all util in one burst lets defenders wait it out and hold the spike with full time once your side is dry. You lose tempo entirely.

sources_option.citation: If you throw all denial at once, defenders wait it out and retake with full time, so you should layer it rather than spending every tool immediately.

options.label: Send one player solo peeking C Long to fish for a pick before grouping for the retake
options.explication_courte: A solo peek into a post-plant crossfire gifts the ATK a free trade and throws away your 3v2 advantage. The retake becomes a 2v2 without coordinated util.

sources_option.citation: Crossfires are the most consistent ranked post-plant win condition; a lone peeker into a linear crossfire is forced into a trade the attackers designed to win.

explication_longue:
Situation: 3v2 retake on C Site Haven, spike planted, 31 seconds on the clock. You're Omen with 2 Dark Covers and Paranoia. The 2 remaining attackers have set up post-plant and are likely holding a crossfire covering the defuse angles (C Long and the default plant toward Garage).

Key retake principle: you don't win the retake by stepping onto the site — you win it by making the defuse impossible for the enemy. In a 3v2 with util, the correct sequence is to deny vision on the post-plants (smoke the firing lines) THEN push grouped to force the 2 ATK to cover more angles than they have players.

Omen's 2 Dark Covers are made exactly for cutting those 2 crossfire lines: one smoke on C Long, one on the default angle. With vision denied, a 3-body push through Garage and Link saturates the defense — the 2 ATK can only hold 2 angles, so the third retaker gets through. Paranoia can be saved for re-clearing if an angle holds out.

Estimated elite distribution: ~58% play the smoke+grouped-entry combo, ~22% try a flash-first entry without smokes (playable but riskier), ~14% dump all util at once, ~4% solo peek (the mistake that throws the numbers advantage). GTO tolerance: any sequence that denies vision BEFORE entering grouped is acceptable.

sources.citation: The retake is won by making the defuse impossible; fundamentals are timing, spacing, crossfire denial, utility layering and coordinated trading.
Smokes reshape vision and decide which players can participate in a fight and from where; layer utility reactively rather than dumping it at once.
Spike detonates 45 seconds after plant; defuse takes 7 seconds with a 3.5s half-defuse checkpoint, leaving room for a coordinated 3v2 retake at 31s.

_gaps.incertitude: Frequences estimees a partir de guides retake (theguide.gg, boosteria, boostroom) et de principes generaux ; aucune donnee statistique Riot par decision. A trancher par 2 juges Immortal+.

Les 2 ATK post-plant sont supposes en crossfire mais leurs positions exactes sont inconnues (ennemis_inconnus_count=2). Un juge pourrait estimer que la ligne optimale depend de l'agent adverse (Killjoy lockdown, Viper wall) non specifie ici.
L'entree Paranoia-first pourrait etre jugee 'optimal' par certains joueurs flash-heavy plutot que 'acceptable' ; la separation optimal/acceptable est fine sur ce puzzle.
